notes.title: UPDATE 0.46 - You Can Now Craft "Robo-Dan"!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959551/0d69a02bb5280d171bd0ff66cd33f9f7e55a53e3.jpg

Another craft-able weapon in the form of a robot in your own image comes in this update!

Just like the previous weapons, you need to first find a blueprint for Robo-Dan from the gold chests that drop off of mobs and also the materials from the green chests that also drop randomly from mobs you kill.

Once you own the blueprint for Robo-Dan, interact with the workbench in the Upgrade room you can visit between levels and the required materials will be shown on the blueprint page. 

After you have crafted Robo-Dan, simply place him anywhere you desire on any level with either the right mouse button or the B button on a gamepad.  Once crafted, Robo-Dan will help you destroy any enemies in his vicinity.  You can disassemble Robo-Dan and get a portion of your materials back by pressing the same button when near him.  Getting some materials back once clearing the level is advised because you'll need to craft a new one before you can place him again.

Currently, Robo-Dan takes no damage from anything, even explosions.  This might change in a future update during balancing, but for now, he's invulnerable once crafted and only you can damage him by disassembling him.

That's it for this update.. as always, more updates to come!


- Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.45 - Begin at Level 1, 5, or 10! - Luck Statue Added! ..Much More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959551/a4380395dadc0b701f018e01eda6e9cbe26fb72f.jpg

Hello again gamers!

I hope that you are enjoying family, friends, and the holidays wherever you are!  On this Thanksgiving day, I spent my morning and early afternoon coding more content for this game, and streamed it all over my on twitch channel in almost a 7 hour livestream!

Here is what I added today with Update 0.45:

* You can can choose a difficulty to start each game at.  "Slow & Easy" starts you off immediately on the battlefield against the shapes of war at level 1..  "Quick Start" starts you off at the upgrade room and gives you 125 Soul Shards to spend before entering the battlefield at level 5.  And finally, "Instant Chaos" will start you in the upgrade room with 300 Soul Shards to upgrade Super Star Dan before entering the battles at level 10.  Your choice every game on how much action you want to start your game with!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959551/751b804ace172007ffc43b7197adb425e470506a.jpg

* A Luck statue was added to the upgrade room and increasing your luck gives you a higher chance on every mob killed of it dropping Soul Shards and loot chests.  This can be upgraded from 0 to 20.

* A new "Soul Shard Buying" statue will offer you score points in exchange for your Soul Shards, but you have to sell all of them to get points in exchange and you also need to have a total score of at least whatever the Soul Shard Buying statue is offering you to exchange your Soul Shards for points.  Keep in mind that you don't ever need to sell your Soul Shards for points, and you'll always keep any unused shards for the next time you enter the Upgrade room.

--------

Changes made in Update 0.45:

- I made each enemy flash when they are hit by your default shot so it's easier to see when you've hit them.

- Adjusted the score value of killing a Parallelogram to about 300% of what it was worth before this update.

- Made sure the running people moved in front of the Parallelogram rather then behind it.

- Slowed down the rotation speed of the enemy triangles.

- Added over 25 new sound effects to the game.

- Made small adjustments and tweaks to several assets that I've created for this game to make it more visually pleasing.


With that, I think I've covered most of everything I added and changed in this update.



Happy Holidays!

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.40 - Upgrade Your Fire Power, Fire Speed and More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959551/f70acec49b16a2c137b4c0c290669d95592b9e8e.jpg

Earlier today, I launched Update 0.39 which added the ability to use Soul Shards to increase your movement speed and I knocked your starting movement speed down to a slower speed until you spend some shards upgrading it.

With Update 0,40 now, I've also added the ability to upgrade both your Fire Power and your Fire Speed and I've also nerfed both of those when you start the game.  You'll find all three of these new purchasable stat increase statues in the Upgrade Room that you can visit between levels by entering the green door.

I've also added a dummy to your Upgrade room so that you can fire your primary weapon at it and see exactly how much damage and how much DPS (Damage Per Second) you are inflicting.  Keep in mind that this dummy, for now, only gives damage and DPS for your primary weapon.  He'll be updated soon to show damage from all your weapons if you have crafted addition weapons at the work bench.

Remember that none of these upgrades will carry over to new games that you start and that you'll also start each game off slow and weak and need to build Super Star Dan up so he can conquer the levels and all of his foes.  In a future update, I will add the ability for players to start things off faster and also more difficult should they choose to.


That's about it for this update.  I hope you enjoy your time facing the "Shapes of War"!



Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.38 - Zippy Zapper Weapon and T-Baggin Dan... Oh My! ..Plus More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959551/015231603491f770d295ce68203a666ec236d08b.jpg

This is a pretty big update that has a lot of new stuff and adjusted items in it, so let's start breaking it all down.

- New! ..A new craft-able weapon is in that I call the 'Zippy Zapper'!  It's an automatic firing gun that zaps all of the shapes in the game and helps you eliminate your foes and clear the levels faster!  This weapon does no damage to innocent people and also reduces the risk of enemy explosions by 60%.

- New! ..Super Star Dan must have been playing some Dead By Daylight or one of those other online sweat-filled games because he is now absolutely full of the toxic tea-bags!  If you kill seven or more enemies in any 10 second period of time, good ol' Dan will now vigorously tea-bag to celebrate.  When you hear the new "baggin' sound", you just need to stop moving to watch Dan do his bags!  You can also hit the SHIFT key on the keyboard or the B button on a game pad to tea-bag dead civilians after all of the mobs have been cleared on any level.

- New! ...Tired of Dan's toxicity and his baggin'?  No worries, just head to the Options page and turn off his tea-bags at any point.  This setting is saved for you so you will not need to set it again every time you launch the game.

- New! ...A brand new blueprint crafting sheet is in and accessed by pressing the action button while close to the crafting workbench in the upgrade room between levels.  Here. you'll see the craft-able weapons that you've acquired blueprints for in the game and what materials it requires to make it.  Note that the materials for each weapon might change every time you come back to the Upgrade room.

- Besides that, there's been a lot of minor changes made to help balance and enhance the game overall.  I've made so many small changes, it's hard for me to remember them all.  It's likely many of these changes will change yet again as I continue to develop the game.

Grab it now to get it before the price increases again if you're interested in helping good ol' Super Star Dan!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.35 - Making Early Levels Much Easier!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959551/907741c7541b9c0d11d4b24254f6b509f8be8f45.jpg

Back again with my 5th update in the last two days since I launched this game...

You know, it's the small things that we often fail to consider that are so vitally important, especially in video games.  All this time as I've been developing this game, I've had the game start off like a wild fire with crazy speeds and instant chaos right away.  This was to help me better get a quick feeling for the gameplay and test my game immediately at it's high point.  

...But just this morning, the thought finally hit me that not everyone who buys this game is going to want it immediately start out with crazy speeds of enemies and mad insanity right away.  Duh!  So, I've changed the early levels so that the harder mobs like the red circles and the yellow trapezoids aren't seen until after level 5.  This should allow people to slowly ramp up to the crazy chaos that was right away before this update.

In a future update, I'll probably add difficulty level options when you start a game so that you have greater control over the difficulty of your game.  For now though, I definitely feel like this will give new players to the game a much better, and less frustrating experience.

In this update, I also added new sound effects for things like collecting the three different materials found in chests.  

I also changed the score values for every mob so that the more difficult mobs are worth way far more points than the slower moving and less dangerous mobs.


As will be the case for the foreseeable future in the development of this game, everything is likely to change, and change often to iron out what I feel like is the best overall game that I can create.

Game on until my next update which will likely come very soon!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... {Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.34 - The First Craftable Weapon Is In!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959551/33909478436f4b9e607f547598fc2f6a2797eaf2.jpg

The first craft able weapon is now in the game, with many more coming!

The mobs now randomly drop GOLD and GREEN chests.  

The GOLD chests contain blueprints, and for now, the only blueprint is for the "Sphere of Vanquishing".

The GREEN chests contain materials.  Silicon, Copper, and Metal can be found and collected from these
green chests when opened.

You can craft the Sphere of Vanquishing at the work table found at the top of the Upgrade room accessed by the green door found at the end of each level.  You must have collected the blueprint and the required materials before it can be crafted.  Walking near the work bench will tell you what materials are required and these requirements can change each time you travel to the Upgrade room between levels.

The Sphere of Vanquishing does NOT harm the innocent people running around and it also reduces the chance of explosions by 75% when it destroys an enemy.

The Sphere of Vanquishing has a durability and will eventually break and you'll need to collect materials to craft a new one at that point.

You can still shoot normally while using the Sphere of Vanquishing and it acts as a second weapon.



I hope you enjoy the first of many new weapons and upgrades coming to 'Life Saver'!


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS ... {Solo Indie Game Developer}

notes.title: UPDATE 0.31 - Added Volume Settings
notes.notes:
Just a quick couple of changes here in the first update of many to come to "Life Saver" in the coming days and weeks..

- I added is the ability to change the game volume anywhere from 0 to 100 with either the up and down arrow keys or the + and - keys on the number pad on your keyboard.  These settings immediately save to your computer when changed so that the next time you launch the game, it will restore the volume you last had set.

- I added the ability to go back to the welcome screen from the pause menu during the game.  Either the Left shoulder button while paused or hitting the 'R' key on your keyboard while paused will end your game and send you back to the welcome screen.


..That's it for now, but definitely wanted to allow players to change the in-game volume and get it out before I start making bigger gameplay changes.



Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)
